chunks.name: 🔁️dictionary-and-registry-laws
chunks.doc: 🔁️ Dictionary and registry laws: the observed system, the dictionary cursor, the echo and double operators, schema round trips, registry dispatch and the custom dispatch pipelines.

chunks.name: 🔀️wire-channel-and-collect-laws
chunks.doc: 🔀️ Wire, channel and collect laws: wire precedence over recorded literals, resolved channels per neuron and fixed and variadic port routing.

chunks.name: 🧵️cluster-and-top-level-laws
chunks.doc: 🧵️ Cluster and top-level laws: the add operator, boundary neurons, cluster contracts and inner trees, top-level evaluation and shakability.

chunks.name: 🗂️cached-evaluation-laws
chunks.doc: 🗂️ Cached evaluation laws: declared defaults, stable node hashes, cache hits, per-node errors and branch recomputation.

chunks.name: ⏱️budgeted-walk-laws
chunks.doc: ⏱️ Budgeted walk laws: remaining and probe walks, resumption across calls, failed dispatch service from the cache, the wall clock and node count caps and the cache epoch refresh before sweep.

chunks.name: 📚️cardinality-and-schema-component-laws
chunks.doc: 📚️ Cardinality and schema component laws: cardinality symbols and counts, heterogeneous list refusal, null atoms and the tri-modal schema component.

chunks.name: 🌊️dirty-set-and-wave-laws
chunks.doc: 🌊️ Dirty set and wave laws: the dirty set for unchanged snapshots, descendants, removals and seeds, and the budgeted wave walks over contributed graphs.

chunks.name: 🚦️owned-control-laws
chunks.doc: 🚦️ Owned control laws: the compact pending extension and the dictionary writer source retirement and original text laws.
